column1: # Tracked allow list for ubs partial scans (TRDD-H7884ERZ). Read by git-hooks/ubs_partial_gate.py from the pre-commit hook.
# Format: one entry per line, 4 fields separated by a TAB character: path, detector, anchor, reason.
#   path     repo-relative path of the file whose ubs scan may end partial (one entry per path)
#   detector the ONE ubs detector allowed to stay unfinished (every partial detector must equal it)
#   anchor   text that appears on exactly ONE line of the HEAD blob: the limit site. A staged diff that changes
#            any HEAD line at or after that line blocks the commit (the code below the anchor is the unscanned part)
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Any other malformed line blocks every ubs exit-2 commit.
# A partial file with no entry, a different detector, or a HEAD blob that is not partial still blocks.
